description: This is a Java test class for the GesturesSettingsFragment in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of gesture settings, including enabling/disabling gestures, showing alerts, and initial state based on preferences.

classes.name: GesturesSettingsFragmentTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending RobolectricFragmentTestCase to test the GesturesSettingsFragment's gesture preferences behavior.

methods.name: getStartFragmentNavigationId
methods.description: Returns the navigation ID to start the fragment, specifically R.id.gesturesSettingsFragment.

methods.name: startFragmentAndSetPrefs
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, finds relevant preferences, and verifies their presence.

methods.name: testDisabledSomeGesturesWhenGestureTypingEnabled
methods.description: Tests toggling the gesture typing preference and verifies the enabled/disabled state of related preferences.

methods.name: testShowAlertWhenEnablingGesture
methods.description: Verifies that enabling gesture typing shows an alert dialog and that dismissing it resets the preference.

methods.name: testStartWithEnabled
methods.description: Tests initial state when the gesture typing preference is enabled via shared preferences and verifies the UI state.
